title: Serve the Chattic.us app at hey.chattic.us; keep marketing at the apex
description:
Owner decision 2026-08-31: **https://chattic.us stays the marketing site.** The Chattic.us `web/` app is not the apex. If the app needs a public hostname besides env subdomains (`dev.chattic.us`, `staging.chattic.us`), that hostname is **https://hey.chattic.us**.

## DoD

- CDK `WEB_SITE_DOMAINS.production` is `hey.chattic.us`, not `chattic.us`.
- `ChatticusWebProduction` does not attach apex or `www` (those remain marketing).
- ACM already covers `*.chattic.us`; do not mint a new apex cert for this slice.
- README / infra README / Gherkin say marketing at apex, app at hey / env hosts.
- Stories a3923e and 0325d4 mean the **app** origin (`hey.chattic.us` in production, `dev.chattic.us` in development), not the marketing apex.
- Live check after an authorized **ChatticusWebProduction-only** deploy: `https://hey.chattic.us/api/health` is ok; `https://chattic.us` remains marketing (not the chat roster).
- No `cdk deploy --all`. No Computers/Snapshots. ThinTurn production only if the web stack cannot alias without it.

Not included: replacing the marketing site, product login, `--all`.
